name: Zpriite 0.5G Live Rosin Disposable
description: Lineage: Blue Dream Cookie Chemchee x Jelly Roll Type: Hybrid Terpenes:Llimonene, Myrcene, Caryophyllene, & Pinene Effects: Uplifting and energizing at first, with a creative, social buzz and mood-brightening euphoria. Smooth transition into a relaxed, easygoing body high without heavy sedation. Perfect for daytime hangs, creative sessions, or sparking up a party. Aroma: Bursting with sweet lemon-lime soda, candy zest, and a subtle herbal undertone. Opens up with bright citrus and finishes with a creamy, fizzy sweetness. Zprite Sativa fizzes with energy and flavor, boasting zesty lemon-lime notes and a crisp, refreshing aroma. This lively strain delivers an uplifting, clear-headed high—perfect for powering through your day or fueling creative pursuits. Stay bright, stay Zprite.
